text:
alex: Deploybot flagged canary p95 > 2s for embeddings route after kernel update. Rolling hold at 20% traffic. Thoughts on rollback vs patch?

deploybot: AUTOMATION: rollout paused at 20%. reason=p95_latency(>2s). suggested_action=manual_review

maya: @alex @sam logs show kvcache miss rate spiked right after the kernel flag flip. Looks like a regression in the new attention kernel. I can revert the flag quickly if we want a lighter change.

sam: Prefer manual rollback to prior model build (v3.4.1) \u2014 safer for customer experience. Who can pin the older revision and cut canary traffic back to 0%?

irene: If we rollback, we need an ASANA ticket and to update the release-notes entry to say "reverted kernel flag change" + notify CS about affected customers. @natalie can you prep a one-paragraph blurb?

natalie: On it. Draft for external: "We've temporarily reverted a performance tweak after detecting increased latency for some embeddings requests. We've restored the previous configuration while we investigate; no customer data was impacted."

alex: Plan: maya to revert kernel flag as a hotfix (non-release) to the canary pool, sam to pin model to v3.4.1 and shift traffic back. I'll handle comms to #prod-alerts and send the customer note. Agree? :thumbsup:

maya: Hotfix command I'll run against canary nodes: ```kubectl set env deploy/infer-runtime KERNEL_FLAG=off -n inference-canary``` I'll run and watch metrics.

sam: For pin & shift I'll run: `redwoodctl rollout pin --model embeddings --version v3.4.1 --scope canary` then `redwoodctl traffic shift --from new:canary --to pinned:canary --percent 100`. Running after maya's change looks stable.

deploybot: ACTION LOG: user=maya action=env_update target=inference-canary status=queued

maya: Done. Env var reverted on canary. Observing p95 and kvcache hits.

deploybot: TELEMETRY: p95_latency for embeddings on canary dropped from 2.8s -> 1.1s over 90s post-change. rollout_resume=false

alex: Sam, proceed with pin + traffic shift when you see stable for 3 minutes. Keep the hold until CS blurb is sent.

sam: Pin applied and traffic shifted. `status=complete` \u2014 canary is back to v3.4.1 and receiving 100% of canary traffic.

alex: Thanks. I'm posting the external blurb and pinging CS. I'll create the postmortem ticket and link recordings. Closing this thread after ASANA ticket exists.

irene: Postmortem created: ASANA-9876 assigned to eng-ml. CS notified with the drafted blurb.

natalie: Posted customer note and added a short FAQ for support. :white_check_mark:
